Given that y1(x)=x5 and y2(x)=1x4 are solutions to the equation x2y″−20y=0, what function must also be a solution to the given differential equation?

a
y=x5+2x4+x2
b
y=3x4x5+1
c
y=x5+22x4
d
y=2x9+3x4
e
y=x5+2x4
